entry.title: Cemetery Commission: the meeting of 19 August 2026 — recording, transcript and our minutes
entry.summary: Cemetery Commission set the North Cemetery expansion bid schedule and moved to raise lot and burial fees. The recording is on the town’s channel (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9B8uWI7kA7w), its captions are searchable, and our minutes are written from them; the video at its timestamp is the record.
